---
title: "Early stages of lipid-droplet formation"
description: "Neutral triglycerides aggregate within a phospholipid bilayer to form a lens-like blister."
order: 5
---

Coarse-grained simulations show neutral triglycerides aggregating inside a phospholipid membrane, an early molecular step toward lipid-droplet biogenesis.
